description: Cross-platform prediction market search. Queries Polymarket, Kalshi, and Drift BET in parallel and returns unified results sorted by volume. Finds the same event across platforms to compare odds and spot arbitrage opportunities. Returns probabilities, volume, liquidity, and cross-platform matches with probability spreads. Costs $0.01 USDC per call.

limit.description: Maximum results to return across all platforms (default: 20)

query.description: Search query — topic, keyword, or question (e.g. 'bitcoin', 'election', 'fed rate cut', 'world cup')

name: prediction_market_aggregator
title: Prediction market aggregator
